content:
Please use Python with urllib to fetch the Wikipedia page for "Survivor (American TV series)" at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Survivor_(American_TV_series). Extract all winner names from seasons 1 through 44. Then also fetch https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Idol and extract all winner names.

Print out the complete list of winners for each show, noting which winners appear more than once. Then compute the number of unique winners for each show and the difference.

arguments.prompt: Extract the list of winners from seasons 1 through 44. Show the HTML structure around the winner names.
